description: This file contains implementations of utility functions for handling sparse tensors in PyTorch, including flattening indices, converting COO format to CSR, and generating full COO indices.

methods.name: flatten_indices
methods.description: Flattens a sparse indices tensor into a 1D tensor, with optional cloning.

methods.name: flatten_indices_by_dims
methods.description: Partially flattens sparse tensor indices over specified dimensions.

methods.name: coo_to_csr
methods.description: Converts COO format indices to CSR format tensor.

methods.name: zeros_like_with_indices
methods.description: Creates a sparse COO tensor with the same indices as input, filled with zeros.

methods.name: full_coo_indices
methods.description: Generates full COO indices for a tensor of given sizes.
